author: CBR
description:
Lanterns is the DCU’s best project yet, combining Aaron Pierre’s standout John Stewart with Kyle Chandler’s Hal Jordan and a gripping Green Lantern murder mystery. After seven of eight episodes, CBR’s Sean O’Connell finds a series that makes DC’s cosmic mythology feel grounded, accessible, and genuinely addictive.

Aaron Pierre feels made for John Stewart, while Kyle Chandler brings the right veteran presence to Hal Jordan. Their mentor-and-rookie dynamic gives the series a strong foundation, especially as Lanterns blends its intergalactic mythology with a grounded, True Detective-style investigation.

The Green Lantern lore is introduced naturally without overwhelming newcomers, while the central mystery keeps revealing just enough to make the next episode difficult to resist. It’s an impressive expansion of James Gunn’s DCU and a particularly strong introduction for a version of John Stewart who could become a major part of the franchise moving forward.
